11 | Invisibility Sphere II | 1 target | 24 hours | 10' | E

# Descriptions
@@ 2
A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24
hours pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon,
falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).
@@ 4
As Unseen I, except everything within 1' of the target is invisible as long as
it is within 1' and as long as none of the Unseen I termination conditions
occur.
@@ 6
As Invisibility I, except the radius can vary up to 1' (chosen at the time of
casting). This makes the invisible target harder to see.
@@ 8
As Invisibility I, except the radius is 10'.
@@ 10
As Unseen I, except 3 objects can be affected.
@@ 11
As Invisibility Sphere I, except the radius can vary up to 10' (chosen at the
time of casting).
@@ 13
As Unseen I, except 5 objects can be affected.
@@ 15
As Invisibility I, except two targets can be affected (with a separate radius
for each).
@@ 17
As Unseen I, except up to 10 objects can be affected.
@@ 18
As Invisibility Split Sphere, except the two radii can vary up to 10' (chosen
at the time of casting).
@@ 20
As Invisibility I, except radius can vary up to 20' (chosen at the time of
casting).
@@ 25
As Unseen I, except as many objects as the caster’s level may be affected.
@@ 30
As Invisibility I, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be
affected. Each target gets its own radius.
@@ 50
As Invisibility II, except only affects the caster. If he attacks he is only
visible for the round immediately following the attack. Violent blows do not
affect this spell.
